quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You may damage a tire if you drift onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You may slow down if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive carefully and watch for construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children in or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn coming on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign means a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a detour is 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must come to a complete stop. Look for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until it is safe before going.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. You do not have to stop unless traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means the lane is open for you to use.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means a yield sign is coming. Be ready to slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road gets slippery when wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you what you must do. This sign means you can turn right or go straight in this lane.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down. The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead makes a sharp turn.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down before you reach the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand are extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand downward, they are signaling they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to wait to turn left until the left turn signal shows it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
Specific lanes allow specific turning movements.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells drivers a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign means no right turn.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles or pedestrians to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or guardrail between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the area ahead has low clearance for tall vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change the normal route. Be prepared to follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the street.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane ends at an exit ramp and does not continue on the freeway. You must either exit or change lanes before the exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead becomes a divided highway. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must or must not do. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection is coming up. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to use when exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They tell drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or next to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is coming up. Be careful—pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign marks either a school crossing or a school zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach this intersection. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This pennant shape is used only for no passing zone signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply right first, then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign means you are approaching a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means vehicles in the left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns you not to enter a road from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic moves in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that the shoulder ahead is lower than the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are multiple lanes for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: From the center lane, what can you do?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane for left turns only from either direction. You cannot use this lane to pass other cars or drive straight.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white rectangles with black markings. You must follow them. This sign means no passing is allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. They alert you to be careful. This sign tells you that the right lane ahead will be closed for construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.
The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road ahead has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road is covered with loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will have less grip on gravel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means large trucks are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for pedestrians and be ready to stop.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell you about road hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous. Orange signs warn drivers about construction. This sign means penalties for unsafe driving are increased in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is posted at traffic lights where turning right on red is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
Fines are doubled in work zones.
A new lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the minimum speed you must drive. You cannot drive slower than the speed shown on this sign.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed when conditions are good.
questions.explanation: The speed limit shows the highest legal speed on that road when conditions are ideal. You may need to drive slower if the weather is bad or the road is not in good condition.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then curves left.
The road ahead curves left, then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then curves left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.
Trucks are on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells you a fire station is nearby and emergency vehicles may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells you that an extra lane is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings tells you to be careful because the road can become slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is closed to traffic.
The road ahead is under maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is under maintenance.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. This sign warns you that you are approaching a work zone. Be ready to slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers they can park for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means the action is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. You should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to respond to yellow lights, red lights, and other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that roadwork is starting ahead. Be careful and watch for workers and equipment.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two one-way sections with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign warns you that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. Follow the arrow and stay on the side it shows.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a bridge with narrow lanes. Slow down and be ready to adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the direction traffic flows on a one-way street. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Let pedestrians and vehicles pass. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to follow a different route because of roadwork or unsafe conditions ahead. Take the detour shown.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road hazards. This sign warns you that something may require you to stop ahead. Stay alert and be ready.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn you about construction. This sign directs you to take a different route because roadwork is changing the normal path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the bridge or overpass ahead is low. Do not go forward if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way to other drivers and pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs mean yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to prevent traffic buildup.
Switch lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Switch lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge.
questions.explanation: When vehicles are merging, make room for them. If another lane is empty and safe, move over to let them enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at the speed shown
The highest legal speed here is 55 mph
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed here is 55 mph
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you may drive on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet
The road ahead has many curves

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther away from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What do these signs indicate?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare drivers for road hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. These object markers warn drivers about hazardous objects or areas to avoid.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right. Slow to 35 mph
Divided highway begins. Slow to 35 mph
Winding road ahead. Slow to 35 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right. Slow to 35 mph
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves to the right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown, which is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a person with a flag is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It shows laws you must follow. Right turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What warning does this sign give?

options.text: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane
questions.explanation: This sign shows the right lane will end ahead on a road with multiple lanes. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone begins after the curve
Drive at least 35 mph around the curve
Curve ahead. 35 mph or slower is recommended
Stay in the right lane if driving 35 mph or slower
